title: Calendar for Auction of Government of India Treasury Bills
description: (For the Quarter ending September 2026) Reserve Bank of India, in consultation with the Government of India, hereby, releases the calendar for issuance of Treasury Bills for the quarter ending September 2026 as under: Notified Amount for Auction of Treasury Bills (July - September, 2026) (₹ crore) Date of Auction Date of Issue 91 Days 182 Days 364 Days Total July 01, 2026 July 02, 2026 9,000 8,000 7,000 24,000 July 08, 2026 July 09, 2026 9,000 8,000 7,000 24,000 July 15, 2026 July 16, 2026
